# Tool catalog

Every tool the agent can offer the model, as the model sees it: the name, the description and the input schema. Local tools live in [packages/agent/src/tools/](../../packages/agent/src/tools). The search tool's schema is generated from the stage's catalog definition, so this catalog shows the example catalog's; any other local tool comes from its `@tool` definition. Gateway tools come from the Gateway targets in the CDK app, synthesized offline from the config templates. A deployment offers the tools in `Config.allowed_tools` ([loader.py](../../packages/infra/config/loader.py)); the template columns show which committed templates turn each one on.

| Tool | Runs | config/dev.toml | config/prod.toml |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`saved-items___get_saved_items`](#saved-items___get_saved_items) | Gateway target `saved-items` | yes | no |
| [`search_products`](#search_products) | Local tool in the agent | yes | yes |

## `saved-items___get_saved_items`

- **Runs:** behind the AgentCore Gateway: target `saved-items`, an AWS Lambda function, called with the Gateway's IAM role. The model sees Gateway tools as `<target>___<tool>`.
- **Defined in:** [packages/infra/stacks/gateway_stack.py](../../packages/infra/stacks/gateway_stack.py); handler [packages/mcp-servers/saved-items-lambda/src/handler.py](../../packages/mcp-servers/saved-items-lambda/src/handler.py)
- **Offered by:** config/dev.toml

Description:

```text
The shopper's saved items (wishlist). Use it when the shopper asks about items they saved.
```

Input schema:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Allowed values and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `5`; max `20` | How many saved items to return (default 5, max 20). |

The schema sets no enum or bound keywords for these parameters; the allowed values and limits shown are the ones their descriptions state.

## `search_products`

- **Runs:** in the agent, as a local Strands tool: no Gateway hop. Its parameters come from the stage's catalog definition (`tools.productSearch.catalogFile`); this is the example catalog's schema.
- **Defined in:** [packages/agent/src/tools/product_search.py](../../packages/agent/src/tools/product_search.py); schema from [packages/catalog/src/aria_catalog/example/catalog.toml](../../packages/catalog/src/aria_catalog/example/catalog.toml)
- **Offered by:** config/dev.toml, config/prod.toml

Description:

```text
Search fashion products in the NORDLY catalog. Use this tool only for searching products.
Prefer the filters to free text, in this order: season, gender, category1, category2, year, usage. Use query only for what they leave out.
```

Input schema:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Allowed values and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | no | at most `200` characters | Free text for what the filters don't cover. It's matched by keyword and by meaning, so a short description of the item works best. At most 200 characters. |
| `season` | string | no | `Summer`, `Fall`, `Winter`, `Spring` | Target season. One of: Summer, Fall, Winter, Spring |
| `gender` | string | no | `Men`, `Women`, `Unisex`, `Boys`, `Girls` | Target gender. One of: Men, Women, Unisex, Boys, Girls |
| `category1` | string | no | `Apparel`, `Accessories`, `Footwear`, `Personal Care`, `Free Items`, `Sporting Goods`, `Home` | Top-level category. One of: Apparel, Accessories, Footwear, Personal Care, Free Items, Sporting Goods, Home |
| `category2` | string | no | `Topwear`, `Shoes`, `Bags`, `Bottomwear`, `Watches`, `Innerwear`, `Jewellery`, `Eyewear`, `Fragrance`, `Sandal`, `Wallets`, `Flip Flops`, `Belts`, `Socks`, `Lips`, `Dress`, `Loungewear and Nightwear`, `Saree`, `Nails`, `Makeup`, `Headwear`, `Ties`, `Accessories`, `Scarves`, `Cufflinks`, `Apparel Set`, `Free Gifts`, `Stoles`, `Skin Care`, `Skin`, `Eyes`, `Mufflers`, `Shoe Accessories`, `Sports Equipment`, `Gloves`, `Hair`, `Bath and Body`, `Water Bottle`, `Perfumes`, `Umbrellas`, `Beauty Accessories`, `Wristbands`, `Sports Accessories`, `Home Furnishing`, `Vouchers` | Sub-category within category1. Jackets and coats are Topwear; sneakers, running shoes and boots are Shoes. One of: Topwear, Shoes, Bags, Bottomwear, Watches, Innerwear, Jewellery, Eyewear, Fragrance, Sandal, Wallets, Flip Flops, Belts, Socks, Lips, Dress, Loungewear and Nightwear, Saree, Nails, Makeup, Headwear, Ties, Accessories, Scarves, Cufflinks, Apparel Set, Free Gifts, Stoles, Skin Care, Skin, Eyes, Mufflers, Shoe Accessories, Sports Equipment, Gloves, Hair, Bath and Body, Water Bottle, Perfumes, Umbrellas, Beauty Accessories, Wristbands, Sports Accessories, Home Furnishing, Vouchers |
| `year` | integer | no |  | Release year, e.g. 2025. |
| `usage` | string | no | `Casual`, `Smart Casual`, `Formal`, `Sports`, `Travel`, `Party`, `Home` | Occasion the product is made for. One of: Casual, Smart Casual, Formal, Sports, Travel, Party, Home |
| `limit` | integer | no | min `1`; max `20`; default `3` | Max results to return (default 3, max 20). |
